newsitem.title: POLAND: Animex's Ekodrob to offer shares in Oct.
newsitem.headline: Animex's Ekodrob to offer shares in Oct.

text.p: Polish meat firm Ekodrob SA, 51-percent owned by food trader and producer Animex SA, plans to issue 1.2 million new shares in October and enter the bourse's parallel market, Ekodrob's president said on Wednesday.

"We plan to carry out an issue of 1.2 million shares in October....We expect the issue price to be between 20 and 30 zlotys," Janusz Lipski told a news conference. He said state-owned bank Pekao SA would underwrite the issue.
Animex president Witold Pereta, also present, said his company would buy a substantial part of the new issue to keep its stake in Ekodrob at around 50 percent.
Lipski said 600,000 of Ekodrob's shares would be offered to small investors, 500,000 to large investors and 100,000 shares would go to the firm's employees and suppliers.

Ekodrob's capital is now divided into 920,000 shares, of which the treasury holds 49 percent. The company plans to net 4.2 million zlotys in 1997 on sales of 120 million, up from last year's 3.3-million-zloty net on 111-million-zloty sales.
